rationale: The fresh deduplicated pool contains 36 exact-fingerprint-unique candidates and 36 declared commercial archetypes with no duplicate or similarity flags. Delayed history was introduced only after this pool was fixed. The immutable shortlist preserves eight distinct mechanisms: a used-EV battery health certificate exchange, a photovoltaic producer-responsibility collective, an allergen change dependency graph, a Legionella lab-channel benchmark, a regulated gambling intervention API, a usage-metered EEG quality gate, a reclaimed-PV component marketplace, and a genetics variant recontact registry. Each has a materially different payer, paid event, control point, and critical dependency. Near-direct historical repeats in passports, EUDR evidence, F-gas ledgers, tender intelligence, AI release evidence, flexibility aggregation, renewable telemetry, generic medical-device vigilance, pay-equity mapping, and grid-site screening were excluded. The selected candidates still carry unproven rights, channel, safety, regulatory, or marketplace dependencies; those are assigned for direct adversarial research rather than treated as validation.
